court: High Court of Judicature at Bombay
trial_court: JMFC, 9th Court at Thane being R.C.C.No. 97 of 2017
case_name: Mihir Harshad Vyas And Ors vs The State Of Maharashtra And Anr

parties.petitioner_plaintiff: Mr. Mihir Harshad Vyas, Mrs. Nayna Harshad Vyas, Mr. Nakul Harshad Vyas (husband, mother-in-law, brother-in-law)
parties.respondent_defendant: The State of Maharashtra, Mrs. Nisha Mihir Vyas (wife)

facts_of_case: Petitioners seek quashing of FIR/complaint registered vide C.R. No. 0144 of 2016 with the Mira Road Police Station, Mumbai for alleged offences punishable under Sections 498-A, 406, 323, 504, 506 read with 34 of the Indian Penal Code. Parties amicably settled their dispute.

legal_principles.principle: A party's consent to quash a criminal proceeding can be taken into account.
legal_principles.held: Perused the papers. The respondent no.2 is present in person. She has tendered her consent affidavit dated 19th August, 2022, duly affirmed before the Assistant Registrar, High Court.

legal_principles.principle: A party's decision to withdraw allegations and complaints can be taken into account.
legal_principles.held: She has stated that she has decided to withdraw all allegations/complaints made by her against the petitioners, including the subject FIR.

legal_principles.principle: A party's consent to settle a dispute can be taken into account.
legal_principles.held: It appears that the parties decided to amicably resolve and settle their dispute.

outcome.final_order: Quashing of FIR/complaint sought and granted.

use_for_drafting: drafting a petition for quashing FIR
